description.value:
Sets one or more attributes from expressions.

`data-attr:<name>="expr"`
`data-attr="{name: expr}"`

Two-way binding between an input element and a signal.

`data-bind:<signal>`
`data-bind="signal"`

**Modifiers:** `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`, `__prop.name`, `__event.a.b`

Toggles CSS classes from boolean expressions.

`data-class:<name>="expr"`
`data-class="{name: expr}"`

**Modifiers:** `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`

A read-only signal derived from other signals.

`data-computed:<signal>="expr"`
`data-computed="{name: () => expr}"`

**Modifiers:** `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`

Runs an expression whenever a signal it reads changes.

`data-effect="expr"`

Datastar leaves this element (and its subtree, unless __self) alone.

`data-ignore`
`data-ignore__self`

**Modifiers:** `__self`

This element is never morphed.

`data-ignore-morph`

A boolean signal that is true while a fetch from this element is in flight.

`data-indicator:<signal>`
`data-indicator="signal"`

**Modifiers:** `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`

Runs an expression once when the element enters the DOM.

`data-init="expr"`

**Modifiers:** `__delay.500ms`, `__viewtransition`

Renders the signal store as JSON into the element. Debugging aid.

`data-json-signals`
`data-json-signals="{include: /re/, exclude: /re/}"`

**Modifiers:** `__terse`

Attaches an event listener. `evt` is the event; `el` the element.

`data-on:<event>="expr"`

**Modifiers:** `__once`, `__passive`, `__capture`, `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`, `__delay.500ms`, `__debounce.500ms (.leading, .notrailing)`, `__throttle.500ms (.noleading, .trailing)`, `__viewtransition`, `__window`, `__document`, `__outside`, `__prevent`, `__stop`

Runs an expression when the element intersects the viewport.

`data-on-intersect="expr"`

**Modifiers:** `__once`, `__exit`, `__half`, `__full`, `__threshold.50`, `__delay.500ms`, `__debounce.500ms (.leading, .notrailing)`, `__throttle.500ms (.noleading, .trailing)`, `__viewtransition`

Runs an expression on an interval (default 1s).

`data-on-interval="expr"`

**Modifiers:** `__duration.500ms (.leading)`, `__viewtransition`

Runs an expression whenever signals are patched. `patch` holds the patch.

`data-on-signal-patch="expr"`

**Modifiers:** `__delay.500ms`, `__debounce.500ms (.leading, .notrailing)`, `__throttle.500ms (.noleading, .trailing)`

Filters which signal patches trigger data-on-signal-patch.

`data-on-signal-patch-filter="{include: /re/, exclude: /re/}"`

Keeps the listed attributes through a morph.

`data-preserve-attr="name name"`

Exposes the element as a signal.

`data-ref:<signal>`
`data-ref="signal"`

**Modifiers:** `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`

Shows the element when the expression is truthy.

`data-show="expr"`

Declares signals. Dotted names create nested signals.

`data-signals:<name>="expr"`
`data-signals="{name: value}"`

**Modifiers:** `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`, `__ifmissing`

Sets inline styles from expressions.

`data-style:<property>="expr"`
`data-style="{property: expr}"`

Sets the element's text content from an expression.

`data-text="expr"`

On the html element: enables CSP mode with this nonce.

`data-nonce="nonce"`

Pro. Animates an attribute whenever the expression's signals change.

`data-animate:<attribute>="expr"`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. Custom form validation: '' is valid, any other string is the message.

`data-custom-validity="expr"`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. A boolean signal that follows a media query.

`data-match-media:<signal>="'query'"`

**Modifiers:** `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. Runs on every animation frame.

`data-on-raf="expr"`

**Modifiers:** `__throttle.500ms (.noleading, .trailing)`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. Runs when the element's size changes.

`data-on-resize="expr"`

**Modifiers:** `__debounce.500ms (.leading, .notrailing)`, `__throttle.500ms (.noleading, .trailing)`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. Persists signals in local or session storage.

`data-persist`
`data-persist:<key>`
`data-persist="{include: /re/}"`

**Modifiers:** `__session`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. Two-way sync between signals and the URL query string.

`data-query-string`
`data-query-string="{include: /re/}"`

**Modifiers:** `__filter`, `__history`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. Replaces the browser URL without reloading.

`data-replace-url="expr"`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. Scrolls the element into view.

`data-scroll-into-view`
`data-scroll-into-view__smooth__vcenter`

**Modifiers:** `__smooth`, `__instant`, `__auto`, `__hstart`, `__hcenter`, `__hend`, `__hnearest`, `__vstart`, `__vcenter`, `__vend`, `__vnearest`, `__focus`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._

Pro. Sets the element's view-transition-name.

`data-view-transition="expr"`

_Datastar Pro. Requires the Pro bundle, which you license and load yourself._
